subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Transport Emissions
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Transport Emissions.

hook.text: Air freight emits 50x more CO₂ per ton-km than ocean freight. The mode you choose defines the footprint.

buildup.text: Transportation is the largest source of supply chain emissions—responsible for 30% of logistics carbon.

discovery.text: Shifting from air to sea, optimizing routes, and consolidating loads all reduce transport emissions.

twist.text: Customers demand fast delivery, which often means air. Speed and sustainability pull in opposite directions.

climax.text: Electric trucks, biofuels, and slow-steaming ships are closing the gap between speed and green.

punchline.text: Choose the mode wisely. The planet rides with the freight.

quiz.question: How much more CO₂ does air freight emit vs. ocean per ton-km?
